in_marathi.name: Anjit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anjit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anjas' which means peace. The suffix 'it' denotes one who is victorious in life. This name is believed to bring peace and success in all endeavors.
